This May, Lux Optics launched the all-new professional camera app Halide Mark III for iPhone. Now, Halide is back with its first update designed for the iPhone 18 Pro, along with new features for all iPhone photography enthusiasts.

At its core, Halide Mark III is built to help iPhone users capture better photos.

It includes a redesigned camera interface, brand-new photo editing tools, and the Halide Looks filter feature, giving your work a distinctive style.

Building on that foundation, Halide 3.1 arrived in July, adding new Halide Looks filters and more.

  • Halide Mark III professional iPhone camera app delivers three major photography upgrades
  • Halide 3.1 adds perspective correction, pure RAW capture, and more

Now Halide 3.2 is officially here, ready to support the upgraded iPhone 18 Pro camera system.

Aperture Priority Mode

This includes Aperture Priority Mode, which builds on Halide's existing capabilities, allowing users to freely choose any f-value between ƒ/1.48 and ƒ/4.0.

(The built-in iPhone "Camera" app supports automatic variable aperture mode, or manual selection of ƒ/1.48, ƒ/1.8, ƒ/2.8, or ƒ/4.0.)

The Aperture Priority Mode in Halide 3.2 for iPhone 18 Pro lets you set your target f-value first, then Halide automatically adjusts shutter speed and ISO based on the shooting environment.

At the same time, full manual mode also supports direct ISO sensitivity control.

New Halide Looks Filters: dawn and quicksilver

In addition, Halide 3.2 brings two new filters to all iPhones: dawn and quicksilver.

dawn "brings a cinematic warm tone to the midtones and highlights, with soft, layered shadows"; quicksilver offers "high contrast paired with low-saturation colors, inspired by silver halide retention craftsmanship".

Finally, Halide 3.2 adds a brand-new 16:9 aspect ratio shooting mode.

Halide Mark III is available as a one-time purchase for $69.99; subscribers can use this new app for $19.99 per year.
